_comment: English text for content/corps.json. Same ids; figures, sources' URLs and anchors come from the French file.

sources.gbd-lbp: GBD 2021 study, low back pain: 619 million people in 2020 (Lancet Rheumatol 2023)
sources.gbd-oa: GBD 2021 study, knee, hand and hip osteoarthritis (Lancet Rheumatol 2023)
sources.gbd-neck: GBD 2021 study, neck pain: 203 million people in 2020 (Lancet Rheumatol 2024)
sources.nix: Nix et al., J Foot Ankle Res 2010
sources.thomas: Thomas et al., BMC Musculoskelet Disord 2019
sources.bridgman: Bridgman et al., Emerg Med J 2003
sources.vanleeuwen: van Leeuwen et al., Fam Pract 2023
sources.vanderwindt: van der Windt et al., Ann Rheum Dis 1995

hallux.name: Hallux valgus
hallux.basis: Adults aged 18 to 65 who have the deformity (36 in 100 after 65), from a review of studies. It is a deformity, often painless: this figure does not count the people who are in pain.
hallux.whatYouFeel: A bump at the base of the big toe, redness and pain when it rubs in the shoe, big toe drifting towards the others.

sfp.name: Patellofemoral pain syndrome
sfp.commonName: Pain at the front of the knee
sfp.basis: Young people aged 7 to 24: new cases seen by a GP in one year (Netherlands). Many people do not see a doctor, so the real number is higher. Especially common in adolescence and in athletes. There is no reliable figure for the whole population.
sfp.whatYouFeel: Pain around or behind the kneecap on stairs, when squatting, or after sitting for long with the knees bent.

talon.name: Plantar fasciopathy
talon.basis: Adults aged 50 and over (UK) who had pain under the heel in the past month, from a questionnaire. This figure does not apply to all ages.
talon.whatYouFeel: Sharp pain under the heel with the first steps in the morning or after sitting, which eases as you walk.

lombalgie.name: Non-specific low back pain
lombalgie.basis: World population in 2020, at a given moment: 619 million people (GBD 2021 study). Population surveys often find more.
lombalgie.whatYouFeel: Pain in the lower back, sometimes in the buttock, that changes with positions and movements.

coiffe.name: Rotator cuff tendinopathy
coiffe.basis: Working-age adults (UK) with shoulder pain, diagnosis confirmed on examination: 4.5 in 100 in men, 6.1 in women.
coiffe.whatYouFeel: Pain on the side of the shoulder and upper arm when lifting the arm, putting on a jacket, or at night when lying on it.

gonarthrose.name: Knee osteoarthritis
gonarthrose.basis: World population in 2020: 365 million people with knee osteoarthritis that shows on X-ray and is painful (GBD 2021 study). Much more common after 50.
gonarthrose.whatYouFeel: Pain when walking and on stairs, stiffness on getting up that eases within a few minutes, knee sometimes swollen.

carpien.name: Carpal tunnel syndrome
carpien.basis: Adults aged 25 to 74 (Sweden), diagnosed on clinical examination: 3.8 in 100. With confirmation by nerve testing: 2.7 in 100.
carpien.whatYouFeel: Pins and needles and numbness in the thumb, index and middle fingers, especially at night, eased by shaking the hand.

entorse.name: Lateral ankle sprain
entorse.basis: England: new ankle sprains seen in emergency departments in one year. Many sprains never reach an emergency department, so the real number is higher.
entorse.whatYouFeel: Pain and swelling on the outer side of the ankle after a twist, sometimes a bruise the next day.

capsulite.name: Adhesive capsulitis
capsulite.basis: New cases of painful, stiff shoulder seen by a GP in one year (Netherlands), calculated from the share of this diagnosis among new shoulder complaints. A figure of 2 to 5 people in 100 over a lifetime is often quoted, with no recent study to confirm it.
capsulite.whatYouFeel: Shoulder pain that is severe at first, especially at night, then a shoulder that becomes stiffer and stiffer in every direction.

cervicalgie.name: Non-specific neck pain
cervicalgie.basis: World population in 2020, at a given moment: 203 million people (GBD 2021 study). Population surveys often find more.
cervicalgie.whatYouFeel: Pain and stiffness in the neck, sometimes spreading to the shoulder or shoulder blade, difficulty turning the head.

arthmain.name: Hand osteoarthritis
arthmain.basis: World population in 2020, at a given moment, age-standardised rate: osteoarthritis of at least one hand joint, visible on X-ray and painful (GBD 2021 study).
arthmain.whatYouFeel: Pain and stiffness in the fingers or at the base of the thumb, knobbly joints, difficulty gripping and unscrewing.

epicondylite.name: Lateral elbow tendinopathy
epicondylite.basis: Working-age adults (UK), diagnosed on examination. Same order of magnitude in Finland: 1.3 in 100.
epicondylite.whatYouFeel: Pain on the outer side of the elbow when gripping, carrying something palm down, or turning a door handle.

quervain.name: De Quervain's tenosynovitis
quervain.commonName: Wrist pain on the thumb side
quervain.basis: Working-age adults (UK), diagnosed on examination. More common in women (1.3 in 100) than in men (0.5 in 100).
quervain.whatYouFeel: Pain at the edge of the wrist on the thumb side when grasping, wringing or lifting a child.

coxarthrose.name: Hip osteoarthritis
coxarthrose.basis: World population in 2020, at a given moment, age-standardised rate: hip osteoarthritis visible on X-ray and painful (GBD 2021 study). Much more common after 50.
